rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement, hardwood flooring, drywall, and stored contents resulting from a burst water supply line in the home is direct damage to insured property covered under homeowners property damage.
claim_summary: Homeowner discovered extensive basement flooding upon return from work trip caused by a burst water supply line. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot, and ruined stored boxes. This is a high-severity property damage claim with estimated damage well above $25,000 that requires prompt mitigation and professional assessment.

case_facts.cause: burst water supply line in policyholder's home
case_facts.incident_date: discovered upon return from work trip
case_facts.estimated_damage: significant structural and contents damage (flooring, drywall, stored items)

rationale: Wind-blown shingles from the roof overhang is direct damage to the structure of the policyholder's home, a clear property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to back porch roof overhang last weekend—four shingles blown off with no interior leaks or additional damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Clear property damage claim under active homeowners policy POL-1006.

case_facts.description: Four shingles blown off by wind, no interior damage or leaks
